English: Singing Stone
A simple, sacred stone at the heart of the camp, used as an assembly point for stories and songs.
Bards Tent
A humble tent set aside for bards and storytellers, where tales and music uplift the clans.
Musicians Pavilion
A sturdy wooden pavilion, hosting music and gatherings, fostering unity and morale.
Recitation Room
A semi-permanent yurt for formal recitals and performances, drawing crowds and inspiring the nomads.
Lyricists Hall
A grand timber hall adorned with intricate carvings, serving as a center for lyricists, poets, and minstrels.
Poets Chamber
Private quarters for esteemed poets, where the most revered compositions are crafted, strengthening clan identity.
Minstrel Gallery
A raised gallery for performances, echoing across the plain, drawing in wandering clans with song and tale.
Eisteddfod Hall
A renowned hall for bardic competitions, where the greatest talents vie for honor, uniting the clans in festivity.
High Bards Den
Luxurious quarters reserved for the chief bard, whose authority binds the clans through song and tradition.
Celtic Bardic Court
A legendary gathering ground where the greatest bards shape the destiny of the people, inspiring the horde to greatness.
